axis: a corrupted name seeded into history, then N real calls

transport_wall.rule: BUG-1085/D-3203 clause 5: call_timeout_s() = per_turn_budget_s + transport_slack_s with 0 < slack < budget - so an overshooting turn is READ and NAMED OVER_BUDGET instead of absorbed, 2x the wall is refused at read time, and the cold load is paid by a 1-token warm-up that is NEVER graded

instrument_allowance.rule: BUG-1081/D-3203: floor(per_turn_budget_s * decode_tps(model)) from config/agent_context.yaml#turn_budget - never a literal

retry_guard.rule: a turn whose owed call the engine's parser ate is RE-ASKED with a nudge that NAMES the missing call - never byte-identically, because R7 pins temperature 0.0 and an identical prompt is a deterministic replay of the same refused header (measured 2026-10-27: 6 identical re-issues recovered 0 of 3); an allowance, a silent stop, a declined call or a turn past the transport wall is NEVER retried

not_tested: enable_thinking=False on a harmony model that emits an analysis channel anyway (a server-side setting this fixture never changes)
the <|channel|>json where <|constrain|>json belongs token confusion: the marker is REPLAYED as a name tail, never produced by the model under observation

which HALF of the seeded pair teaches the copy: `blank-echo` now separates the verbatim NAME in the echo from the seeded assistant turn, but the FULLY UNBALANCED transcript (an assistant tool_call with NO tool response at all) is a different axis - it changes structure as well as content, and an engine that refuses it would return a transport error, not a reading
